name: Relentless grants its buff and cuts Aortic Assault's cooldown on physical crits (#694)
contract: Relentless 704652's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Relentless 807357. Spell.dbc gives 704652 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Physical critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of Aortic Assault by $/1000;807358s1 sec and grant you Relentless' at ProcChance 100. The cooldown half lives in Relentless 807358, a single SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN with BasePoints -1001 and MiscValue 806212, which nothing ever cast - it is not the EffectTriggerSpell of any effect on 704652 or 807357 - hence the spell_linked_spell row that fires it with 807357. Spell::EffectAscensionModifyCooldown resolves MiscValue as an exact spell id, so only 806212's stored cooldown moves, while every Aortic Assault rank shares Category 53 with CategoryRecoveryTime 20000 and therefore receives the same 20000 ms when rank 807785 (the rank a level-80 character owns) is cast. Comparing 806212's remaining cooldown against 807785's at the same moment is therefore time-independent: they start equal and only the proc can separate them. Crit Test Buff 503747 (aura 290, +100 percentage points) removes the crit roll, and Bloodfang Bite 572551 is SchoolMask 1 DmgClass 2, the physical melee-damage-class event the row names. The third tooltip clause, 807357's own aura-42 extension of Taldaram's Torment through 807359, is not exercised here.
